home.aboutIntro: Hi there! I'm an Information Management graduate student at NKUST with a heart for UI/UX and Human Factors. My journey has taken me from analyzing data at e-Excellence Inc. to exploring new perspectives during an exchange at THWS in Germany, all of which fuels my focus on creating accessible and beautifully structured interfaces. These days, I'm pouring my energy into optimizing OSCE medical system backends through User-Centered Design (UCD) — striving to turn complex technical logic into an intuitive experience that truly serves its users.
beyondGridParagraphs: When I'm not refining pixels or analyzing datasets, I immerse myself in illustration and digital art. My love for visual storytelling often translates into my web projects, where I enjoy integrating unique character designs.

Having served as a Student Ambassador and International Volunteer in Würzburg, I have a deep appreciation for cross-cultural exchange and travel photography. I believe that observing the world from different perspectives fuels my creativity and empathy as a designer.

portfolio.eyebrow: Bridging the gap between technical logic and human-centered intuition.
portfolio.headline: Portfolio
portfolio.intro: I'm a designer who's honestly just obsessed with how people actually function. To me, design isn't just about 'looking good'—it's about Human Factors and hard evidence. I rely on eye-tracking, emotional responses, and user interviews to prove that a layout actually works. Whether I'm cleaning up a chaotic technical interface or geeking out over dark mode aesthetics, I love thinking outside the box to turn complex digital friction into a smooth, 'it just works' experience.
